challenge.title: Reimbursement in the Gulf is moving to outcomes. Most hospitals cannot prove them.
challenge.body: As GCC payers shift to Pay-for-Quality and Value-Based Payment models, hospitals are paid for results rather than volume. But the evidence that decides those payments — patient-reported outcomes — is still collected on paper, late, and from a fraction of the population. Meanwhile emergency departments absorb cases that were never emergencies.

points.title: Outcomes go unmeasured
points.body: PROMs are collected sporadically and rarely reach the HIS in time to support a reimbursement case.

points.title: Emergency departments absorb the overflow
points.body: A large share of ER presentations could have been safely resolved in a clinic, on a call, or at home.

points.title: Care stops at the clinic door
points.body: Between visits patients have no vetted source of guidance, so adherence slips and readmissions rise.

how.title: One continuous loop, from first symptom to proven outcome.
how.subtitle: Three connected modules. The patient's voice opens the loop; measured outcomes close it.

steps.name: Voice Triage
steps.title: AI analyses the patient's voice the moment symptoms are described.
steps.body: The patient speaks naturally in their own dialect. HaaliHealth transcribes, extracts clinical signals and scores urgency against your protocols — then routes them to self-care, a clinic slot, or the emergency department, with a structured report waiting in the HIS before they arrive.
bullets: Natural speech in local Arabic dialects and English
Urgency scoring mapped to your own triage protocols
Structured pre-arrival report pushed to the HIS

steps.name: Haali Voice
steps.title: A health companion that stays with the patient between visits.
steps.body: Haali Voice answers patient questions around the clock — but only from clinically vetted material and the patient's own health profile. It never improvises. It handles the routine questions that would otherwise reach your nurses, and keeps patients adherent to the plan they left with.
bullets: Answers restricted to vetted clinical content — no open-ended generation
Personalised to the patient's conditions and medications
Deflects routine calls and messages away from clinical staff

steps.name: Automated PROMs
steps.title: Real-time patient-reported outcomes, delivered straight to your HIS.
steps.body: Standardised outcome measures are collected inside the patient's normal routine rather than as a separate chore — so response rates hold. Results stream back into your systems as quantifiable evidence of treatment effectiveness, ready for the insurer.
bullets: Live dashboards and automated clinical reports
Reimbursement-ready evidence for P4Q and VBP contracts

benefits.title: Why hospital leaders choose HaaliHealth
benefits.subtitle: The voice layer wins back capacity today. The outcomes layer protects your reimbursement tomorrow.

stats.label: Continuous patient support
stats.hint: Haali Voice responds at any hour

cards.title: Higher insurance reimbursements
cards.body: Quantified, real-time PROMs give you objective proof of treatment effectiveness — the evidence that decides your rate under Pay-for-Quality and Value-Based Payment contracts.

cards.title: Reduced ER waiting times
cards.body: Non-urgent cases are identified and redirected before they reach the door, so your emergency department keeps its capacity for the patients who genuinely need it.

cards.title: Full local dialect support
cards.body: Built for how patients actually speak across the Gulf and the wider region — not a translated model. Accurate understanding means accurate triage.

cards.title: Clinical staff time returned
cards.body: Haali Voice absorbs routine questions and a structured report arrives ahead of the patient, so clinicians spend their time on care rather than on intake and repetition.

cards.title: Measurably higher patient satisfaction
cards.body: Immediate answers, vetted guidance and follow-up that does not stop at discharge — reflected directly in the experience scores your board reviews.

cards.title: Fewer avoidable readmissions
cards.body: Outcome data often signals deterioration earlier than clinical data alone. Catching it early keeps patients out of the ward and protects your quality metrics.

safeguards.body: Patient data encrypted in transit and at rest

safeguards.body: Hosted in region; data does not leave it

safeguards.title: Full Audit Trail

security.roadmapNote: We hold none of the certifications below yet. Each is actively in progress, and this page will be updated the moment one is formally awarded — not before.
security.integrationTitle: Seamless integration with your HIS / EHR
security.integrationBody: HaaliHealth connects to the systems you already run through standards-based interfaces — no rip-and-replace, no parallel record. Triage reports and PROMs land in the patient chart where your clinicians already work.
security.note: We will share our current security documentation, architecture and certification timeline under NDA during technical due diligence.
